question: Can I keep the generated head readable with indentation? Do I need a new YAML setting? What happens to my custom head snippets?
expected: From v2.1.1 the theme emits separate document opening and head lines with consistent HTML/JSON-LD indentation. Existing compress_html.blanklines: true, already in configuration examples, preserves head indentation while removing blank lines and clipping the body. No new setting is needed. Other compression modes follow existing site settings. Custom includes retain their own formatting; avoid Liquid trims across HTML boundaries.

question: My page uses custom2, which inherits custom1, which inherits archive. Will it still be h-feed? Do I need a YAML flag in my page?
expected: From v2.1.1 custom layouts inheriting archive, indexcategory, cloudtag or cloudcategory retain h-feed through multiple layout layers. No additional page YAML setting or configuration option is needed; the built-in list layouts propagate the internal feed metadata automatically.

question: Which Chulapa list layouts provide h-feed? Do I need new YAML options or does including indexcards automatically create a feed?
expected: From v2.1.1 archive, indexcategory, cloudtag and cloudcategory and their deprecated aliases use h-feed with nested h-entry items. No new YAML options. indexcards and simplelist mark entries only; custom pages need their own feed wrapper. The pagination example provides h-feed per page. Cloud lists can repeat entries across groups.

question: Where do I configure my site author's profile URL? Can I use /about/ and will guest authors inherit it?
expected: Use author.url in _config.yml, alongside name, avatar, location and links. It accepts a profile URL or site-relative path such as /about/; paths resolve with site url/baseurl. It supplies the default article:author URL for posts and, from v2.1.1, u-url in visible Microformats2 author cards. A page author does not inherit the site author's profile URL. Social links remain in author.links.

question: W3C says my Related posts h5 skips heading levels. Does Chulapa choose that heading? How can I keep small text?
expected: related_label and random_label render the user's HTML unchanged. Choose a heading matching the page hierarchy, such as h2 for a separate section, and use class h5 for its visual size. No new configuration option is needed.

question: In v2.1.1, does minimal create a Microformats entry? How do updated dates and guest author URLs work?
expected: Minimal does not declare an automatic h-entry; custom content can supply its own wrapper with p-name, u-url and e-content. Default and landingpage retain automatic entry markup. With show_date enabled, updated pages retain dt-published and dt-updated. Visible h-card uses the selected author.url, resolves relative paths with url/baseurl and does not inherit a site profile URL for a guest.
